title: GBPUSD M30 Candidate Evaluation with Repaired ResetWeek() and London Open Delay (InpLondonOpen=11)
research_question: Does evaluating candidate CAND-0036 (incorporating the repaired ResetWeek() weekly target reset logic alongside InpLondonOpen=11, InpUseFib382=false, and InpTP2Pips=15.0) allow the EA to properly reset weekly profit targets every week across the 5-year training window while maintaining the +$259.33 profitability on 2026 UNSEEN?
hypothesis: Because the ResetWeek() architectural flaw in historical candidates caused trading to freeze permanently after the first 5% gain in 2020, executing CAND-0036 with the repaired week index reset logic will allow genuine multi-year weekly resets. Combining this with the verified InpLondonOpen=11 opening rush filter will prevent premature freezes and maintain positive expectancy across both 5-year training and 2026 UNSEEN partitions.

facts: In EXP-0061 (2026 UNSEEN), InpLondonOpen=11 achieved positive net profit (+$259.33, PF 1.23, WR 56.0%, DD 5.30%).
In EXP-0058 and EXP-0034, trading prematurely halted on 2020.07.23 after reaching $10,500 due to the ResetWeek() Monday comparison bug.
The ResetWeek() defect in Fibonacci_EA_v5_0 has been repaired to use deterministic calendar week index tracking ((t + 4*86400) / (7*86400)).
inferences: With ResetWeek() repaired, weekly 5% target locks will release cleanly on Sunday midnight/Monday open.
The EA will trade the full 5-year training duration with active weekly risk locking rather than halting permanently.
evidence: EXP-0058 total_trades=7, halted after 2020.07.23 due to permanent g_weeklyLocked state

independent_variables.name: InpLondonOpen
independent_variables.rationale: Delays London open window to 11:00 server time, bypassing the 10:00 opening rush while utilizing the repaired ResetWeek() weekly cycle logic.

assumptions: ResetWeek() properly resets g_weeklyLocked at the start of each calendar week.
2026 UNSEEN execution will match or exceed EXP-0061 (+259.33).
expected_observations: Weekly resets occur cleanly across all 5 years without permanent freezing.
2026 UNSEEN net profit remains positive (> +$200.00) with drawdown <= 6.0%.
falsification_conditions: Trading halts permanently after the first 5% weekly target.
